webgpu_fireworks.title: Fireworks Superplugin Settings
webgpu_fireworks.subtitle: GPU-Accelerated Fireworks for TikTok LIVE

toaster_mode.title: 🍞 Toaster Mode (Low-End PCs)
toaster_mode.description: Keeps WebGPU active with reduced trails, bloom and render scale
toaster_mode.help: Optimized for weak systems and maximum compatibility
toaster_mode.gpu: GPU compute and rendering remain active
toaster_mode.tip: Use Toaster Mode if your PC slows down during fireworks or if you experience rendering issues in OBS.

webgpu_fireworks.performance_info: These settings protect against freezes during many simultaneous events. Lower values = more stability.
webgpu_fireworks.frame_skip_info: Frame Skip activates when FPS drops below this value
webgpu_fireworks.overlay_popup_blocked: Could not open overlay window. Please allow pop-ups.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Choose a preset based on your system's performance. Use the Benchmark to find the optimal settings.
presets.tip_text: Use the Benchmark tab to automatically determine the best 2 presets for your system.
presets.warning_title: Warning: This preset might lag on your system!
presets.warning_fps: The benchmark measured an average FPS of {fps}.
presets.warning_confirm: Do you want to use this setting anyway?

benchmark.title: Performance Benchmark
benchmark.description: Run an automatic performance test to find the optimal settings for your system.
benchmark.info_text: The benchmark opens the OBS overlay window and runs various scenarios. This takes about 1-2 minutes. Do not close the window during the test.
benchmark.popup_blocked: Could not open benchmark window. Please allow pop-ups.
benchmark.no_good_presets: No preset reaches 30 FPS. We recommend the "Potato" preset for your system.

webgpu_fireworks.toggle_the_entire_fireworks_system_on_of: Toggle the entire fireworks system on/off
webgpu_fireworks.click_shapes_to_activate_deactivate_for_: Click shapes to activate/deactivate for random selection. Selected shapes have gold border.
webgpu_fireworks.when_enabled_user_profile_pictures_will_: When enabled, user profile pictures will be mixed with gift images as particles
webgpu_fireworks.higher_values_more_avatar_particles_vs_g: Higher values = more avatar particles vs. gift images
webgpu_fireworks.use_this_url_in_obs: Use this URL in OBS as a Browser Source.
webgpu_fireworks.webgpu_obs_notice: This plugin edition is intended exclusively for the Loggableim OBS WebGPU build. It is not supported in standard OBS.
webgpu_fireworks.get_webgpu_build: Get the required OBS WebGPU build
